en: The image depicts a busy industrial port with multiple cargo ships docked along the quay. There are several large cranes for unloading and loading goods, and a densely built cityscape with numerous mid- to high-rise buildings in the background. The overall color palette and photographic style suggest a vintage aesthetic, likely from the mid-20th century. No visible text is present on the front side of the postcard.
